title: Retrieval-augmented generation vs. deterministic tax computation in multi-agent financial advisory: A 2x2 factorial experiment
abstract: arXiv:2608.23908v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tax-loss harvesting demonstrates consistent benefits to long-term portfolio growth; yet implementing it efficiently often involves complex considerations that are specific to the holdings within that portfolio and the individual who owns it. We introduce a custom capital gains calculation engine and a RAG-retrieved vector store of market advisory reports to provide context for a multi-agent trade recommendation system. We investigate the effects of each context provider on the quality of recommendations, measured by relative capital gains incurred during portfolio liquidation. translated_title: 检索增强生成与确定性税务计算在多智能体财务咨询中的对比：一项2x2因子实验
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.23908v1 公告类型：新 摘要：税收损失收割对长期投资组合增长具有一致的好处；然而，高效实施它通常涉及复杂考量，这些考量特定于该投资组合中的持仓及其所有者。我们引入了一个自定义资本利得计算引擎和一个基于RAG检索的市场咨询报告向量存储，为多智能体交易推荐系统提供上下文。我们调查了每个上下文提供者对推荐质量的影响，通过投资组合清算期间产生的相对资本利得来衡量。一项2x2重复测量方差分析显示，税务优化引擎存在显著的主效应（$F(1,29) = 9.17$, $p = .005$, $\eta^2_p = .240$）：启用该引擎使税收节省相对于无引擎条件减少了约55个百分点。RAG主效应不显著（$p = .841$），交互作用也不显著（$p = .553$）。仅RAG条件...
tldr: 本研究通过2x2因子实验发现，在多智能体财务咨询中，确定性税务计算引擎显著影响推荐质量，而RAG上下文提供者无显著效果，且启用税务引擎反而降低了税收节省。
en_tdlr: This study, via a 2x2 factorial experiment, found that a deterministic tax computation engine significantly impacted recommendation quality in multi-agent financial advisory, while RAG context had no significant effect, and enabling the tax engine actually reduced tax savings.
